continuity.question: Was hat sich seit gestern geändert?
continuity.answer: The frontier-pacing debate still lacks shared release thresholds or embedded-evaluator mechanics, while a more operational control layer became concrete: Microsoft published an authority hierarchy for future models; South Korea is preparing an agent-security checklist; China already specifies intervention/recovery/final-human-control requirements; Anthropic simultaneously deepened regulated enterprise workflow integration in finance.

candidates.reason: Concrete primary design rules with direct agent-security implications and independent context.
Material verticalization move with concrete connectors, workflow skills and governance features; claims could be constrained to verifiable product facts.
Fresh policy signal directly aligned with persistent agent-security watch; treated as reported because final guide is not yet public.
Operational intervention/block/recovery/human-control requirements materially complicate the false binary of slowdown versus no safety mechanism.
Strong continuity delta: Europe combines no-halt positioning with sovereign compute and governance; forward-looking numbers explicitly labeled projections.
Novel evaluation surface for agentic unlearning across internal/tool channels; practical security relevance, but early/unreplicated.
Concrete provenance-preserving memory architecture with practical context-engineering implications; early/unreplicated.
Useful guidance but no sufficiently material new architecture or measured evidence relative to existing coverage.
Announcement-level signal with lower immediate builder value than the operational authority/runtime controls selected.
Outside the novelty window or duplicative of already tracked serving/platform developments.

clusters.summary: Microsoft instruction authority, KISA agent-security guidance and Chinese intervention/recovery requirements independently point toward explicit, testable control semantics rather than model-intent-only safety.
Claude for Financial Advisors shifts differentiation into connectors, workflow skills, audit logs and regulated-domain operating artifacts.
European policymakers increasingly frame continued AI development, regional compute capacity and safety governance as complementary rather than mutually exclusive.
K-Bench and CueMem independently push evaluation/design toward internal agent state, provenance and tool-channel evidence rather than final answers alone.

claims.evidence_policy: Story evidence derives from claim evidence. Vendor/product claims remain scoped to documented features; research-paper results remain early signals unless independently reproduced.

source_contributions.contribution: Independent reporting/triangulation for four published story areas plus material caveats.
Primary authority hierarchy, human-control constraints and explicit scope caveats.
Primary financial-advisor product, connector, compliance-skill and audit-log details.
K-Bench and CueMem primary papers; both labeled early/unreplicated.
No new essay in window; prior pacing proposal used only as continuity context.

contrarian_evidence.finding: Microsoft explicitly says the draft is not used to train current models and is descriptive/aspirational rather than a guarantee of current behavior.
contrarian_evidence.disposition: Published caveat; no current-model compliance claim made.

contrarian_evidence.finding: Compliance skill/audit logs are features, not proof of legal compliance; ability to serve more households lacks independent productivity evidence.
contrarian_evidence.disposition: Outcome claims excluded or explicitly caveated.

contrarian_evidence.finding: Lagarde's capacity-gap and productivity figures are projections, not realized deployment/economic effects.
Guidelines/rules do not prove deployed agent systems can satisfy intervention, recovery or control guarantees.
contrarian_evidence.disposition: Published as policy evidence, not effectiveness evidence.

contrarian_evidence.finding: No independent replication surfaced in today's research set.

emerging_signals.thesis: AI control is shifting from general principles toward explicit authority/runtime contracts spanning instruction hierarchy, intervention, recovery, audit and human override.
independent_evidence: South Korea KISA agent-security checklist work
Anthropic regulated workflow audit/compliance product features
emerging_signals.falsifier: Signal weakens if these mechanisms remain documentation only and production agents continue to rely primarily on model-level refusal without enforceable runtime gates.

prediction_reviews.reason: No qualifying Anthropic/OpenAI evaluator identity, access, stop/escalation or reporting details surfaced.
Operational agent controls advanced, but no qualifying frontier release threshold, evaluator stop-rights, U.S.-China testing commitment or U.S. legislative mechanism surfaced.
No comparable post-migration production evaluation or resolved immutable-version telemetry cleared the threshold.

thesis_reviews.reason: Microsoft/KISA/China strengthen externalized policy/runtime-control direction, but the two-platform customer-facing runtime-policy plus customer-telemetry criterion is not yet satisfied.

eval_references.reason: No material new model/runtime release could be fairly compared in a pinned configured house-eval harness; ad-hoc scores would be non-comparable.

red_team_report.goal: Attempt to falsify the brief before publishing.

findings.issue: Microsoft code could be misread as current-model behavior.
findings.fix: Added explicit not-current-training/descriptive-and-aspirational caveat throughout claim graph and brief.

findings.issue: Anthropic compliance/productivity language could overstate outcomes.
findings.fix: Kept only documented features as confirmed; excluded guaranteed-compliance and measured-productivity claims.

findings.issue: Lagarde's 6x/4% figures are forecasts rather than observations.
findings.fix: Marked as projections and avoided presenting them as realized capacity/productivity.

findings.issue: K-Bench/CueMem could be mistaken for established production results.
findings.fix: Labeled early/unreplicated and kept in Research Digest rather than main evidence pillars.

findings.issue: Today's governance story could repeat Sep14 pacing narrative without new information.
findings.fix: Editorial lead explicitly centers the new operational authority/runtime-control delta and does not republish unchanged IPO/pacing stories.

findings.issue: Generated or unverified visuals could violate media policy.
findings.fix: No stock or generative editorial imagery used; concept visual is an internally generated schematic based on cited primary authority semantics.
Both editions generated from one research set with equivalent claims, caveats and watch items.

publish_decision.reason: All mandatory gates passed; no unresolved material contradiction remains.
